title: Exact sections on the affine-neighbourhood strict henselization
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme and $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point. For the actual pointed-affine-neighbourhood coordinate-ring colimit and its spectrum $T=\operatorname{Spec}(\mathrm{strictHenselizationRing}(s))$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], the global sections functor [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor] from abelian sheaves on the small etale site of $T$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] to abelian groups preserves finite colimits. This concerns the specified colimit scheme, without identifying it definitionally with another strict localization.

proof.text: Apply strictHenselizationLocalStructure to the coordinate-ring colimit itself, obtaining local and strictly henselian ring structures. Install those structures locally; the scheme is its spectrum by definition.

For this strictly henselian local ring, Scheme.preservesEpimorphisms_sheafSections_of_isStrictlyHenselianLocalRing supplies preservation of epimorphisms by sections at the terminal etale object. Transfer this through Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections to global sections. Global sections are additive and preserve kernels. Functor.preservesHomology_of_preservesEpis_and_kernels gives preservation of homology, and preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology gives the conclusion.
